spec: §14.8 (owner Q1b group: items 14 stable-enumeration, 15 dispatch-dir, 16 vscode-oplog-holes, 17 vscode-end-guard, 21 live-host)
summary: Capture sorts sub-agent and receipt listings itself (R13), skips a directory sub-agent transcript instead of aborting the dispatch loop (R16), tolerates VS Code op-log holes (R14), guards the VS Code end so a timestamp-less session is not re-appended (R15), and labels provisional live lines with their real host (R19). Item 14 has no corpus diff (POSIX listings are already sorted); its evidence is an unsorted-readdirSync unit test.

cov-capture-vscode-edges.reason: Holes in a replayed op-log no longer drop the session (item 16), and a timestamp-less session is appended once instead of on every sweep (item 17), so the sweep ledger and counts change.

cov-capture-dispatch-edges.reason: A directory where a sub-agent transcript should be skips only that dispatch with a stderr note instead of aborting the loop with EISDIR (item 15); the Copilot live record also names its host (item 21).

cov-copilot-dispatch.reason: The Copilot live dispatch log now carries its own host, so the provisional live line is labelled copilot and de-duplicates against the captured session instead of double-counting as a claude session (item 21).
